attBesluta.text: Petit chariot fonctionnel Très peu encombrant surtout une fois replié Utilisé pour transporter des bagages Sa faible largeur le rend vite instable dès que le terrain devient moins lisse Mais pour le prix… ça fait le job
Love it and when done folds down so nicely can handle quite a bit of weight as well. Shipping was fast as well.
Perfect size, weight and 'foldabiluty' to walk my caravan's toilet cassette to the dump point! Couldn't be happier...
Very light duty, I think the rated 110 lbs would crush it. Suitable for moving a suitcase around or similar. It is easy to use and folds into a very compact unit.

I like the compactness of this folding hand truck. It is sturdy, and easy to use. Also, it can be carried by hand, or put in a larger backpack. It stores easily under my bed, without having to slide it across my hard faux wood floor (I just maneuver it with the front wheels, and pivot). The thing I don't like is that, it doesn't store well in the standing position, as there is no wheel break, so when leaned, the rear wheels just roll out from under it. Otherwise, at the price, it's a good buy.
My inflatable paddle board fits perfectly. Makes moving the board back and forth to the lake a breeze.
Erittäin toimiva ratkaisu silloin, kun TV:tä ei saa kiinnitettyä seinään. On riittävän tukeva eikä tarvitse pelätä kaatumista. Suosittelen!

Tent was easy to put up and had plenty of room for 3 ebikes. I did have problems taking it down. The cord in one of the long poles broke and all the pieces had to be fished out. I did not like the bottom of the main door to be velcro instead of a zipper. Hard to get your hand on both sides of the fabric to press it closed. Had some heavy rain and the bikes inside stayed dry!
Hankittiin vanhenevan koiran liikkumisen helpottamiseksi. Tukevat ja näppärät kun taittuu kasaan. Meidän koira on hieman arka, mutta ei aristellut näitä portaita.

Meidän 8kg koira opetteli muutaman kerran käyttämään rappusia sitten alkoi sujua! Koira liikkuu niissä nyt helposti ja saa esim pidettyä vauhdin rauhallisena, ei tarvitse juosta tai ponnistaa, askellus onnistuu kävelyvauhtia! Olemme oikein tyytyväisiä!
